batting.name: MD Shanaka

balls.text: Full, wide and slammed over long-off! 27 runs off the final over!

And now it's full and wide, Ferreira slogs this right back at Rashid who can only get a hand on it and deflect it towards long-off. Rashid wants them to keep it down to a single but Jadeja and Ferreira make sure they get two, and importantly, keep Ferreira on strike
Oh my, Ferreira goes 6, 6, 6 Another long-hop and this time he's flat-batted this straight of long-off
Now he's overpitched and Ferreira nails the slog-sweep over cow corner! Floated up on the stumps and Ferreira connects well
Rashid is short again there and punished again! Half-tracker outside off and Ferreira just waits on it and boshes it down the ground straight of long-on
Length ball angled across, slapped to cover and they take off for a risky single. The throw comes in at the striker's end but it's not quick enough and it also deflects off Ferreira
Bouncer outside off jags in and Ferreira looks to pull. The top edge goes just over the short fine leg fielder and it's too quick for the fielder to save any runs
Prasidh looks for the yorker, Jadeja shuffles across to scoop but ends up with a leading edge that dribbles to cover
Full around off, heaved away wide of long-on
Good placement! Prasidh just misses his yorker by a bit, ending up as a slot ball outside off, and Ferreira crunches it away through the gap at cover point, beating deep point by a fair but
Banged in short outside off, 130kph, Ferreira goes for the pull but is beaten by the bounce and he ends up getting out of the way
Length ball following Jadeja down leg. He manages to flick it out to deep square leg
Shrot ball on leg, pulled out to deep midwicket. Rabada's last over goes for just five runs, and the big wicket of Vaibhav Sooryavanshi
On a length outside off, punched to backward point
Slower ball on a length outside off, punched down the ground
Ferreira works this full ball between deep midwicket and long-on for a couple

Oh boy, Sooryavanshi falls short by four runs this time! He was out for 97 in the last game, he goes for 96 today. Silence all around as Sooryavanshi looks to tennis-smash this short ball. Like in the last game, this ends up going up off the toe end and it's a simple catch at deep third, where Prasidh takes the catch. Very similar to how he got out in the last game, and he's distraught. The silence soon makes way for applause as he walks off

Jadeja shuffles across to scoop and Rabada fires it wide and across him. Jadeja this time adjusts to just glide it down to deep third and do what everyone wanted him to do -- get Sooryavanshi on strike
Slog-swept in style! Full and straying down leg and Sooryavanshi boshes this over deep backward square with a smooth swing of the bat. On 96 now!
On a length outside off, clipped to long-on
On a length outside off, chopped out to deep point
Low full toss outside off, Sooryavanshi swings it along the carpet to deep midwicket
In the slot outside off and Sooryavanshi just smashes this flat and down the ground, just straight of long-on.  Jadeja at the non-striker's end can't help but applaud his partner
Flung full and Jadeja eases it down to long-on to get the man boy of the hour on strike
Holder goes for a loopy 131kph yorker around middle and it's dug back out to the bowler
Full and wide now from Holder, and he smacks it down the ground. This time Gill is able to give chase from mid-off and keep it down to two

Another short ball angled across, Sooryavanshi backs away and plays another tennis forearm smash, this time with the bat still more horizontal, and it goes a bit wider this time of long-off and drops just short of the ropes

Gill gives chase for a long way but ends up watching it sail over for a six! It's a short ball ending up outside him, and Sooryavanshi takes it on with a tennis-forearm smash. It's the shot that got him out against SRH, but this time it goes all the way down the ground! That was hit with a vertical bat, bringing the bat down as he slapped it down the ground
Now Holder goes for the yorker on off, dug out to mid-off

Imperious! Holder goes short and across and Sooryavanshi just stands tall and slaps it away over cover! That takes him to 1000 IPL runs! In barely two seasons! Incredible stuff. Fastest Indian to 1000 IPL runs
Length ball angled across, punched to backward point. Siraj closes out the over, and his spell, with a dot
Siraj sees Jadeja shape up for the scoop/lap as he goes across the stumps, so bowls it full and across Jadeja, who misses the shot
On a length around leg, clipped to midwicket
Length ball cramping him for room, punched down to long-on

Sooryavanshi looks to take on this length ball but it veers away, taking an edge that goes down to deep third. The throw comes into Siraj, but is high for him, and the overthrow allows Sooryavanshi to get back on strike

Takes on the short ball and it flies over the fine leg boundary! Gets inside the line of this short ball outside leg and gets a bit of a top-edge, but with the ball fired in at 143kph, it still goes all the way
Now Jadeja shuffles leg-side and looks to work this length ball away, but just gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball drops in front
Back of length outside leg, Jadeja wants to work this leg side but ends up parrying it in front
Full and angled across him, Sooryavanshi reaches out and lofts it down the ground, but doesn't quite middle it. Lands short of long-on running to his right
Length ball angled across, Jadeja runs it down to deep third

Ouch! Short ball into Sooryavanshi's torso and he looks to pull. The ball goes off the top edge into his helmet and dribbles fine on the off side. They scamper for the run before physios come out for a concussion test. Rabada apologises while Siraj comes over to check on the youngster
Full outside off and Sooryavanshi with a stunning inside-out shot, lofted over cover and he just clears the ropes!. That's the longer boundary, but that doesn't deter Sooryavanshi

Short ball aimed at Sooryavanshi, who pulls it out to deep square leg to bring up a 31-ball fifty, which is his slowest in the IPL! Back-to-back fifties in RR's two knockout games this season for the 15-year-old
Full outside off, Jadeja eases a drive through point

Edged, and taken. The Archer experiment is done as GT celebrate a fifth wicket! Test match stuff, a length ball outside off that straightens off the pitch, drawing Archer into the drive. Archer goes at it at full tilt and gets a thick edge and Buttler does the rest
Oh, that's well hit by Jofra Archer! It's only slightly short and it sits up nicely at hip-height for Archer, who swivels and hammers his pull in front of square and it flies all the way

Oh, in the air but lands safe. Short ball outside off and Sooryavanshi gets a top edge on this pull. The ball lobs up but this time it's well short of Sai Sudharsan running in from deep backward square
Good stuff from Prasidh, who goes back of length outside off. Sooryavanshi just pushes at it and the ball pops towards point off the splice
Bouncer flashed across Sooryavanshi, who looks to pull. Gets it square on the leg side off the bottom edge. Very good over from Holder. Just two runs and a wicket
Fuller side of good length, Archer eases it towards mid-off for a quick run

Leading edge lands safe! Was almost two-in-two for Jason Holder! Archer closes the face of the bat early on this length ball with some extra bounce and the ball pops to cover's right. Mid-off can't get there either

The short-ball ploy has worked so well for Gujarat Titans today! Shanaka has feathered it behind! Banged in short outside off and angling into Shanaka, who looks for the pull. He's cramped for room and gloves it behind and it's bread, butter, eggs and bacon for Jos Buttler!
Bouncer outside off, Shanaka lets it go
141kph length ball outside off, eased to backward point
142kph bouncer angling into him, Sooryavanshi ducks under it
Shuffles across to this length ball just outside off, tucked to long leg
Full and wide, Shanaka shoulders arms
Length ball angling into him, 146kph, Shanaka nudges it fine and wants a single but Buttler is quick to it. Some confusion between the batters and they decide against a risky run

Dropped by Sai Sudharsan! Short ball climbs on Sooryavanshi who looks to hook it fine. Miscues it and the ball goes high in the air. Sai Sudharsan runs in from deep backward square and dives forward but misjudges it. He was slow to start moving towards the ball as well. Could be a huge moment in this match!
Brilliiant! Prasidh looks for the wide yorker but doesn't quite get the length right and Sooryavanshi hammers it over cover with his fast hands
Yes-no with the running. No direct hit. Was a back of length ball flicked to midwicket, Shanaka was halfway through, VS sent him back
Fullish ball on off, defended to point
Full on middle, flicked to deep midwicket

Slot ball, caught at the boundary. Parag, expressionless, stands still as Holder upper-cuts the air in celebration. This was full on leg at 132ks, flicked it a touch too early, toed it to deep midwicket.
Back of length outside off, 131ks, steered to backward point
Fuller side of length outside off, 131ks, good bounce. Square driven to deep point
Length on leg, beats the flick and goes off the pad to the off side
Flicked the length ball to long-on
Short and that's slog swept! 94ks on leg stump, Sooryavanshi is in the crease, upper-body swivels and bat goes from down to up to send the ball behind square.
Gives it air, goes full outside off. Parag looks to drive through cover, smothers it to long-on
Worse ball, punished again. Much shorter and sits up too, launches a pull over deep midwicket. 83 metres
Effortless pull. Shortish and a bit of width, 93ks, legbreak sits up and is hit flat over midwicket
Ducks under a short ball and practices a ramp. Short over off, not too much bounce and slow off the pitch
Tap and run to cover point. Length on off, delivered from wide of the crease
Short and floaty outside off, 135ks, let go
Back in the crease and across to fourth stump goes Jadeja to toe a straight-bat defence. On the bounce to the keeper

Jadeja was worried about that rolling back onto the stumps, it did hit the back leg but landed to the right and stopped. Back of length at the stumps, defended off the back foot with a closing face. Inside-halved it

Dances down and cuts it over backward point. Hit flat, rolls fast after landing. Was a shortish ball over middle and off, Jadeja danced and got on one leg. Ball hit upper-half of the bat and just under the sticker. Jadeja calls the physio, ump calls for the timeout.
Length just outside off, chopped to cover point
Length on middle and off, flicked to deep midwicket
Goes back, gets square on and pulls it from leg stump to deep-backward square. 102ks
Length on middle, 101ks, flicked to long-on. Batters have to settle for one again
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket. 100ks
Pitched up outside off, over-hits it a touch. Wanted to drive off-side, got it to long-on. 98ks
Nudges it off the back foot through wide mid-on. Wanted two. Not on. Length ball on top of middle
Pulled now. Three boundaries in the same region this over. Short fine leg in and Prasidh goes short over leg again. Pulled off chest-height.
Length in the channel, back-foot punch takes it to backward point
Hooked again. One bounce over the fence. Short on the ribs, Jadeja stands side-on, swivels and gets it well over short fine leg
Length on leg, beats the flick and goes forward off the bat
Hooks it fine. 87-metre six. Short ball high on the chest, Jadeja staying in the crease and swivelling with the bat proper horizontal

Well, Jadeja takes a chance and just about gets away with it. Rawat (sub) charged back from cover and dove with arms spread as he knew he wasn't in reach of the ball as it came down. Was a back of length ball angling in, Jadeja charged and slapped it
Makes room and slashes it off middle stump. 139ks shortish ball on the top of the stumps. Not a bad ball, treated like one. Siraj is back into the dugour

Wide not given, Sooryavanshi reviews straightaway. That looked high. Gotta praise Siraj, pumping it short at 142ks despite the niggle. From side-on (off-side), it looks like a fair ball actually. Sooryavanshi did get on his toes and is beaten on the cut. Head's 1.843 metres, ball's 1.841 metres. So very marginal

Beats the back-away cut. Siraj is in pain again. He's grimacing but will brave through. Held his shoulder right after delivering. Was a shorish ball outside off, Sooryavanshi got on one leg and looked to cut over the infield
Fifty up for RR. Back of length outside off, cut to deep-backward point
Much wider on a length, goes for a hard cut. Beaten
Cut off a length through point. Not much bounce helping Jadeja there. Gill has a word with Siraj

Sightscreen six to a ball that had no business going there! 153ks back of length on off, Sooryavanshi opens his stance just a bit and swings from third through mid-on. It's a vertical bat, impact was low and off the middle. Travels 91 metres
Not in reach again. Rabada appeals for caught behind, no interest from ump. Hard length outside off at 138ks, Sooryavanshi looking to go over cover again
Shortish ball beats bat. Sooryavanshi makes space and looks to go over cover again. Not in reach
Not a bouncer but just as hostile. 151ks shortish ball on fourth, Sooryavanshi stands beside and goes for the pull. Swings his head leg side and misses
Flays it over extra cover. Clears the front leg and launches it over the infield with a big downswing and follow-through. Length ball at pace in the channel
Run down to deep third. Wide on a back of length, steered off the back foot with an open face
Whips it behind square again. Deep fielder there was removed a couple of balls back, two fours went there since. This was a touch fuller than the last ball, batter using his wrists nicely

Swept fine. Not a sweepable ball as such. Back of leg on top of leg stump, Sooryavanshi got back in the crease, got the front foot down leg and then got on one knee. Smushed it off the inside-half of the bat
Two-bounce four behind the keeper. 146ks was way too short and shot like it was off a trampoline. Buttler jumped and reached up, got nowhere close
Shot. Not timed but the deep fielder was well behind square. This finished in the outfield at square leg. Plugs after landing. Pitched up on leg, close-faced swing across the body
Cloths a pull through square leg, Krishna runs right to stop it. Back of length on off, skiddy ball. Sooryvanshi's front leg is braced and back leg is on middle
Out... No! Clears Rabada at mid-on with ease. Hard length just outside off, cross-bat slap across the line. Ball went off the bottom of the bat
Prof was right, it's all short stuff to Sooryavanshi. 144ks leg-stump-landing bouncer goes over off. Sooryavanshi takes his eye off and pulls. Beaten
Guided wide of slip. Opens the face and uses the vertical bat to steer the length ball

Pitched up and Rabada strikes! He went full and on middle and off, 146ks and may have seamed away a touch. Jurel stood on leg and went for a lofted off drive. Bat-face opened and it floated high to mid-off.
Pitched up at the stumps, driven to mid-on
Change of length. Half-volley on leg stump. Flicked to midwicket
Short and wide, carved over backward point. Hit from chest-height. Bounce the only upside for Rabada
Back of length on leg, flicked to deep-backward square

Buttler appeals, Siraj interested too. Not given. Gill runs across, doesn't review. Short ball landed on leg and finishes over off at head-height. Sooryavanshi wanted to drag it square with a pull. Stood beside it and swung the bat like it was a long whip. Seems to have beaten him. Ultra-Edge confirms no edge
Shortish outside off, cut to deep third

Placement fails Jaiswal, he launched a pull, seemed like he wanted to get it much finer but top-edged it to deep-backward square. 139ks short of length at the hips, shot was on but it'll be a first-over wicket for Siraj
Pulled, not great timing. Off the bottom-half of the bat, face closes too. Clears the infield and goes over square leg. Shortish ball at 139ks at the waist
Rises on him. Batter outside the crease, looks to work it away off the back foot, leg side. Loses his bottom hand and drops the ball in front. Shortish ball landed on leg and swung in
Should've been four. Shortish and wide, cut to the right of Sundar at point. Was close to him and rapid, he half-stopped it

And there it is! Rahul Tewatia slams this slot ball down the ground to complete Gujarat Titans' highest successful chase, and sends them into their third IPL final! Shubman Gill and Sai Sudharsan set it up with a stunning partnership, that was ended in bizarre fashion, but there are no slip-ups for GT, and they will now take on RCB in the final at their home in Ahmedabad
Short and wide, left alone. Umpires feel that's a perfectly legal delivery
Full outside off, Tewatia now lofts it over cover. In a hurry here to finish this off
And now they are just six runs away. Back of length delivery angled into him and he helps it along fine on the leg side, to the short fine fielder's right
Yorker on off, squeezed out towards cover for a quick single
Full outside off, he doesn't quite get to the pitch of it but manages to loft it over extra cover. Archer from mid-off has some chasing to do
Another bouncer, this time Tewatia looks for the ramp but can't connect. Wide signalled for height. RR review the wide. Ball-tracking shows the right call was made
Bouncer outside off, Tewatia ducks under it
Full outside off, Tewatia stretches forward and parries towards cover
Full outside off, Tewatia drives to cover

Washington miscues it and Ferreira grabs a good catch. Tries to take on this length ball outside off, but it's a cutter and he's early into the shot. Goes high in the air and Ferreira at long-on has to run in and to his left to get under it, and the South African makes no mistake
Banged in short outside off, Buttler sways out of the way
Full around off, chipped down to long-on
Ah, stunning! This time he goes all the way. Full outside off, and it's another glorious loft over extra cover, but timed even better
Full outside off, not quite a half-volley, but Washington gets a good stride forward and he lofts it over extra cover
Good stuff from Archer, 148.5kph length ball outside off that veers away past the outside edge as Washy pushes at it
Length ball outside off, 148.4kph, steered down to deep third
Stunning shot! Right in the slot on middle and Washington clears his front leg and flicks this majestically over midwicket. One-bounce four
Length ball seams in from outside off, clipped to midwicket's left
Yorker outside off, squeezed away to deep point
Yorker just outside off, Washington jams his bat down to squeeze it fine of short third
Full around middle, crisply tucked to midwicket, but the fielder does well to not let it go past
Full outside off, Buttler drives it wide of long-off

Oh, that looks plumb, and it's given! Gill misses his flick and Archer raps him on the pads. This was full around off and swerving in slightly. Muted celebrations from Archer and RR as Gill walks back after having all but won the game for his team. It's a cliche, but that was a "captain's knock"
Extra bounce takes Gill by surprise. It rises sharply from a length outside off and Gill fends late. Outside edge takes it to deep third
Dug in short-ish and Gill short-arm jabs it to long-on
Slower ball, full on middle, Gill works it to midwicket
On a length around off, clipped to deep fine leg
Back of length outside off, chopped fine on the off side, to deep third's right
In the blockhole outside off, squeezed to deep cover
On a length on off, Buttler tucks it into the vacant midwicket region
Floated full outside off, this time he eases it out to deep cover

They call him the Prince, and this is as princely an innings as you can ask for! With a place in the final on the line, and his team set a challenging 215, Gill has brought out a majestic century! Dances down the track again to this full ball tossed up on the stumps and creams a drive over cover
Full around off, clipped through square leg
Tossed up full outside off, Gill eases a drive to long-off
On a length outside off, eased through covers and they pick up two

Oh my, B Sai Sudharsan is hit wicket twice in two innings! This is unbeleivable! Low full toss outside off and he drives it with an open face. The ball goes away fine on the off side for four, but in his follow through, the bat goes flying out of his hands and lands on the stumps. Gill is on his haunches, he can't believe it, and neither can Sai Sudharsan! Even Jurel is sympathetic as he comes over and hands SaiSu his bat back, and gives him a pat on the shoulder
Slower short ball outside off, chopped to point for a single
Bouncer outside off, and that's too high
Whack! Short outside off and Gill gets on top of the bounce and pulls it imperiously through midwicket
On a length outside off, slapped away to deep point
Overpitched outside off and that's creamed through cover! Sai Sudharsan presses across and places it square of the diving fielder
Uffff, stop it Gill! Now it's a back of length slower delivery angled in from outside off and out comes the short-arm jab, placed well in front of the deep square leg fielder

You just have to sit back and enjoy this man batting, when he's in this kind of form. Just so good to watch. Slot ball floated up on off and Gill keeps his balance as he uses those powerful wrists to flick it over midwicket
Goes full and wide and Gill shapes to hit it but leaves it alone. And that's just inside the tramline
Full outside off, driven to cover, where the fielder can only deflect it towards mid-off, allowing a single
Bouncer outside off, left alone and it's called wide as well
Short and wide, Gill slaps it down to wide long-off. Takes him to 700 runs this season
On a length just outside off, Sai Suds tucks it to midwicket's right for a quick run
Only a touch short and Gill rocks back to heave this over midwicket. In the gap between deep midwicket and long-on, so they pick up two
Even more glorious! Gill skips down the crease again and this time he lofts it over extra cover. Bounces just short of the rope
WHAAAAM! This is overpitched outside off and Gill crisply drives it through cover as he skips down the track. The fielder at cover had no chance
On a length just outside off and spinning in, cut to backward point
Works this length ball off his pads through midwicket
Oh, what strokeplay! This is a googly on a length that's spinning away from him and he goes on the back foot to muscle it over cover! Off a spinner! Incredible. Brings up his fifty too
Slow on a length at off. Cut through cover point. Oh... thought that'll go straight to the fielder but the only fielder in play was deep cover and he was way too straight
Shovels a pull over fine leg. It's a short-arm swipe across the belly. Gill was on one knee as he top-edged it, but the timing was good enough. Jadeja a touch too short and straight, punished
Length outside off, cut to deep point
Dances down again, gets followed by a length ball just down leg. Hits it inside out over cover
Makes room as he dances down and clobbers it over long-on. Swung across his body, picked it off a full length. Not fully down to the pitch but used the room to heave it flat.
Length on off, flicked off the back foot to deep midwicket
Short, and maybe slow, outside off. Gill jumps and cuts to the left of deep point. Shanaka slides and stops the ball, but he rolls to the other side and the ball parries onto the cushion

Seemed like he made too much room, but no, Gill middles the cut to bring up his seventh fifty in the season. Points his point as he raises it in celebration. Was a back of length ball on middle hit from the leg stump tramline through extra cover
Wide on a back of length, cut hard. One bounce to deep cover. Gill punches Sudharsan's gloves with power as GT bring up hundred
Pitched up at the stumps, punched to long-on

Whatapull! Gill seemed to take his eyes off the head-high bouncer but that was very late and the hands never lost speed as the ball was hit off the sweet spot. Might have hit the lady on the chair there. Hope she's okay. That went very flat
Length on leg, flicked to deep fine leg. 136ks
Length on fifth, cut with the spin again. Not as well timed. Goes to cover. 90ks
Wide on a length, cut with the spin. Deep cover point runs right and keeps it to two.
Length ball lands on off and goes away with the angle, worked off the back foot to square leg

To the other side of cover this time. Good ball this time. Touch wide but almost fuller than length, Sudharsan nonetheless goes back in the crease and slices a late cut behind point. Similar to the shot he was hit wicket off in the last game. Holds onto the grip this time
Same length, this one angles away from the leftie and Sudharsan slaps it through cover.
Legbreak on a back of length. Lands on off and turns away. 88ks. Cut to deep point
Slow full toss dips a bit but is very wide and Gill has ample time to adjust. Slaps to long-off
Pitched up on leg, beats the flick en route to keeper

138ks full ball around off, driven with a big back-lift to long-off's right. Archer doesn't have to run much but the batters get two. Followed by a check for one short. Sudharsan the runner, was a few inches short as he slid late, makes it to the crease but doesn't cross it. Penalised
Second head-high bouncer. This is over-head in fact. Landed very short just outside off and finished over the batter as he left
Looked like back of hand again. 120ks. Wide on a length, cut to deep cover point
Slower back of length ball on leg, flicked to deep-backward square
Bouncer outside off, let go. Was it slow? DOesn't look like it on replay. Landed on the way to the keeper
That's a length ball hit like a half-volley. No concerns at all as Gill goes back in the crease and punches it from outside off through extra cover. VS watches with folded arms

Wristy whip to mid-on. 135ks full ball around off, Sudharsan is back in the crease, moves to off stump and doesn't use his feet much as he hits it. Timeout and Matthew Hayden calmly walks in as Gill gets a shoulder massage
Good ball. Skiddy on a length at off, flicked to the leg side of the pitch
Slower one pulled with max comfort. Sudharsan stands still again, waits for the 116ks back of length ball arrive outside off. Hits it in front of the body. Through midwicket
Not far from a yorker but Sudharsan's drilled a drive through extra cover. Sudharsan standing back in the crease helped as that ball landed inches n front of the crease.
Pitched up on the pads, flicked to deep fine leg
Yorker on off, punched to cover. Sudharsan showed all stumps before delivery
Overpitched 122ks ball on middle, Gill stays leg side and chips a drive over mid-on. Fielder present at long-on
Variable bounce again. Slower ball it turns out, likely back of hand. 124ks. Back of length, lands on off and finishes around middle. Gill charges and slaps it to cover
Gill unhappy again as he finds backward point. Back of length 135ks just outside off, cut nicely
Chips a drive over extra cover. Half-volley on fourth stump, Gill took a small stride forward, got his back foot leg side and muscled it
Looked like the same ball, but this 130ks ball doesn't bounce as much and is slower. Pulled to deep square leg
Hits the bat hard, nearly creates a chance. One bounce to midwicket. Shortish ball angled in at the chest, Sudharsan pulled it from around chest-height

Chance? Byes called. GT bring up fifty. Short from around the wicket, landed around middle and angled in. Gill made room, was on one leg as he looked to carve it behind point. Ball bounced nicely and beat both batter and keeper. Judging by replay, that was well above head
Length outside off, guided to deep third

Driven through cover. Checked shot to a 144ks fullish ball. Maybe a touch fuller than length if at all. It swung back in towards fourth stump. Sudharsan stood on middle and off and stayed upright while hitting it
Length around off, worked towards midwicket
Back of length on off, defended straight

Top edge. Miles high. Ferreira drops it! He ran into the outfield at forward square leg and stopped, was looking above his shoulder and was falling to the left while reaching forward. Barely got fingers on it if any. Shanaka was coming in from the deep, but the call had been made. Was a shortish ball that didn't rise much, Sudharsan pulled from under the hips
Gill not happy upon finding backward point. Length ball shaping away outside off, met with a back-foot square punch
Thumped straight of mid-on. Gill ready for the change of length, it's full and just outside off. Driven hard with a full follow-through, almost as though he was playing a spinner
Pulled behind square. 151ks but not rushed at all! Short ball at the chest, Gill gets square-on and pulls it from in front of the body. Ball hit the base of the sticker, one-bounce four
Yorker on middle. Has Sudharsan sliding and getting the bat down for survival. Inside-edges it behind square leg side
Fullish outside off, stabbed through backward point
Good start. Length on off, defended to the bowler's left
Shortish on the hips, flicked to deep-backward square. Two called, settle for one. 139ks
Full outside off, cover drive goes straight. Mid-off stops it
Fullish length ball on leg, flicked through midwicket
Length ball angling away outside off, cut to deep third. 146ks
Rises with the bounce and clips the back-of-length ball on off to square leg
Length ball swings back into off, cut to deep third

Wild outswing. Starting line's wide, the fullish ball lands close to the tramline and keeps going away. Jurel threw himself to the right, deflected it wide of first slip off the gloves. Gill shaped to play before leaving
